lines.en: I hover and drift forward
A ring of flesh-colored matter stirs
I do not walk, I slide
Slime trails behind me
I drift a circle around a tree
The wind nudges me and I drift off course
I drift deeper into the crimson forest
I have no feet, I cannot land

lines.zh: 身体一缩一放地往前走
lines.en: My body pulses as it moves
I drift low, close to the ground
The trees around here are all red

lines.zh: 绯红森林的血肉，我一口就吸。
lines.en: Crimson flesh, one gulp.
I float and slowly contract
One eye on me, watching you
Slime drips down onto the ground
I need not stand, I float
I am listening to the forest
My body never stops moving
This crimson place is comfortable

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，掉了点液体
lines.en: I shudder and a drop of fluid falls
I am not tired, I am just waiting
The air is slightly sweet
You carry no red glow

lines.zh: 我悬在你肩后，盯着颈侧的脉。
lines.en: Hovering behind your shoulder, I watch the pulse in your neck.
You stand too steadily

lines.zh: 你身上有一股新鲜的味道
lines.en: You have a fresh smell
I am closer to the ground than you think

lines.zh: 你退一步，我扑扇着追半步。
lines.en: You step back; I flap after you half a step.
This eye of mine does not blink
Your hand is reaching behind you
Do you know what I am
This forest is good for both of us

lines.zh: 一块血肉掉在地上，还在动。
lines.en: A chunk of me falls and keeps twitching.
I pulled myself up a little
Red fluid runs off me

lines.zh: 被打穿一个洞，我照样飘着。
lines.en: Punched through, I float all the same.
My eye contracted once
So I can feel pain after all
I gather myself back together

lines.zh: 血滴甩出去，我往树后缩。
lines.en: Drops of blood fly off; I shrink behind a tree.
I have lost a layer of slime
You are tougher than I thought
That is not enough to draw in
It glows in your hand
I do not eat solid things
You bring it to feed me
That trace of blood will not draw me
Bring it closer, let me smell

lines.zh: 我吸了一口气，它就干了
lines.en: I breathe in and it dries out
Do not put your hand into my body
It has no taste left

lines.zh: 我喜欢活的，不喜欢这个。
lines.en: I like it alive; this does not suit me.
You walked into my body
My body is soft, and it sticks
A thread of slime stretched as you pulled away

lines.zh: 我的表皮一缩，包住了你的手
lines.en: My surface closed on your hand
You have red fluid on you
I am not heavy, but I do not yield

lines.zh: 这一下让你打了个冷颤
lines.en: That made you shiver

lines.zh: 你撞散我一角，血肉又聚回来。
lines.en: You scatter a corner of me; the flesh gathers back.
What you touched was hot

lines.zh: 你的甲片压进我身体里，退开。
lines.en: Your armor sinks into my body. Back off.
There are many of us in the crimson forest
Two floating together would stick

lines.zh: 我们靠得很近才认得出
lines.en: We must come close to recognize each other
Kin do not bite, we only touch
We hang between the trees together

lines.zh: 我悬着飘过去，黏液拖在身后。
lines.en: I hover over, slime trailing behind me.
Our eyes look at each other
After a while we drift apart

lines.zh: 森林里的红色够养我们
lines.en: The forest's red is enough for us
After the next rain we will meet more

lines.zh: 绯红森林里，我一冲就到了。
lines.en: In the crimson forest, one dash closes the gap.
It dissolved inside me
I wrap it in slime

lines.zh: 滴下来的黏液，牙齿啃不动。
lines.en: The slime I drip cannot chew through this.
I spat it out

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西我够不到
lines.en: I cannot reach things on the ground
I hover above it
Not enough to wrap
I leave it by the roots
You dropped it, and I cannot use it
You carry the smell of red
This eye has locked onto you
I drift toward you
You do not yet know I am behind
You are the only thing moving

lines.zh: 我的黏液已经准备好了
lines.en: My slime is ready

lines.zh: 这一片树上都是我的痕
lines.en: My marks are on every tree here

lines.zh: 你走进来了，就别急着走
lines.en: You came in, do not be quick to leave
I do not call, I only come near

lines.zh: 这一下会很快，血腥脊椎在滴。
lines.en: This will be quick; the bloody spine drips.
I come in from the side
You turned the wrong way
The distance is enough
I begin to contract

lines.zh: 绯红林里，你的体温像火把。
lines.en: In the crimson wood, your warmth is a torch.
I am right behind this tree
You run faster than I drift
But this forest has no exit
I drift at your rear flank

lines.zh: 我的身体一缩，就快一点
lines.en: Each contraction speeds me up

lines.zh: 黏液落在你走过的地上
lines.en: Slime falls where you walked
I do not need to breathe

lines.zh: 你每停一次，我就近一点
lines.en: Each time you stop, I come closer
The red on the trees helps me
Do you hear that sticky sound
My eye has never left you
There are no straight paths in this forest
My outline can spread
You have backed into a patch of red

lines.zh: 这里到处是我留下的液
lines.en: My fluid is everywhere here
One more step and I lunge
Your feet are starting to slip
No hurry, I am always here
Your forehead is beginning to sweat

lines.zh: 绯红森林里，我冲一段再飞。
lines.en: In the crimson forest, I dash and fly.
I am above your head
You looked up at the wrong moment
Now, this is the moment
I lunge and my slime flies

lines.zh: 我的身体包住了你的手
lines.en: My body closed on your hand
That blow was soft, and heavy

lines.zh: 我吸了一口，你有点发晕
lines.en: I drew in once and you went dizzy
My skin pressed on your face
Red fluid splatters out
I come around behind you
That came with heat
You spun in place
I pull back and press in again
That eye of mine is on you
That is only the beginning
You are coated now
I drew in too fast
Struggling will not help

lines.zh: 我从绯红林里冲一下就到。
lines.en: One dash from the crimson wood and I am there.
I press down with my whole body
This layer will smother you
I cling and drag you back
You are wrapped up now

lines.zh: 我从绯红森林的红里出来
lines.en: I come out of the crimson forest's red
My eye surfaces first

lines.zh: 树上多了一团黏黏的东西
lines.en: A sticky lump appears on the tree
I contract my body once first

lines.zh: 这里红色够多，我很舒服
lines.en: There is enough red here, I am comfortable
Nobody else is in this wood
I slide down between the leaves
My slime fell all over the ground
I am in the red haze
There is only me this time

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向有热的地方
lines.en: I turn toward where the heat is
This wood is mine
My body is drying in the heat
I hit the ground and splashed wide
Water thins me out
The blast broke my shape
Something flying passed through me
That force pressed me down

lines.zh: 没有红可吸，我越来越淡
lines.en: No red to draw, I grow faint

lines.zh: 雷过我的时候我整个人亮了
lines.en: Lightning made all of me light up
There is no red in the void
